Hardware Design Verification Intern - AI Accelerators

Help us build the next generation of neural network accelerators.

Responsibilities
- Write SystemVerilog RTL and testbenches for compute blocks (MAC arrays, FSM controllers)
- Build cocotb and Verilator regression suites against Python golden models
- Work on INT8 quantization flows from PyTorch/ONNX models down to hardware
- Debug designs on FPGA platforms

Requirements
- Experience with Verilog or SystemVerilog and digital design
- Python scripting for verification
- Computer architecture coursework

Nice to have
- Compiler experience (MLIR, LLVM)
- Experience with UVM
